CAMPUS SPORTS COMMITTEE
ANNUAL INTER-COLLEGE ATHLETICS MEET 2026

Notice for Team Registrations:
All department sports coordinators are hereby informed that the Annual Athletics Meet will be conducted in December.

Tentative Schedule:
The tentative deadline for student entry submission is 10 December 2026 (subject to university sports council approval).
Dates are provisional and may change depending on weather conditions.

Registration Fee:
Tentative fee of Rs. 250 per participant (provisional, awaiting final sanction).

Events: 100m sprint, 400m relay, long jump, shot put.
Eligibility: Open to all bonafide students.

For inquiries, contact the Physical Education Department ground office.
